beginner.zh: GWAS 比較「有某疾病」和「沒有」的一大群人，在整個基因體裡找出在病人中比較常見的 SNP。找到的是「關聯」，不代表那個 SNP 就是病因：關聯不等於因果。
beginner.en: GWAS compares large groups with and without a disease, scanning the whole genome for SNPs that are more common in patients. What it finds is association — not proof that the SNP causes the disease.

advanced.zh: 對每個 SNP 以迴歸檢定 genotype dosage 與 phenotype 的關聯（連續性狀用線性迴歸、二元性狀用邏輯斯迴歸），並納入主成分等共變數校正族群分層。顯著 SNP 常透過 LD 標記附近未知的因果變異，需要 fine-mapping 與功能研究才能推論機制。
advanced.en: Each SNP is tested by regressing phenotype on genotype dosage (linear for quantitative, logistic for binary traits), adjusting for covariates such as principal components to control population stratification. Significant SNPs often tag unknown causal variants via LD; fine-mapping and functional work are needed to infer mechanism.

zh: （示意）10,000 名病例與 10,000 名對照中，某 SNP 的 T allele 頻率分別為 32% 與 28%。
en: (Illustrative) Among 10,000 cases and 10,000 controls, a SNP's T allele frequency is 32% vs 28%.

beginner.zh: 距離很近的 SNP 常常「一起被遺傳」，像同一節車廂的乘客一起上下車。所以看到其中一個，就能猜到另一個。
beginner.en: SNPs close together are often inherited together, like passengers in the same carriage. Seeing one lets you guess the other.

advanced.zh: LD 是不同基因座 allele 的非隨機關聯。常用 D = p_AB − p_A·p_B 與 r² = D² / [p_A(1−p_A)p_B(1−p_B)]。重組會隨世代打散 LD，且 LD 結構因族群歷史而異；這也是 GWAS 結果與 PRS 跨族群移植性受限的原因之一。
advanced.en: LD is the nonrandom association of alleles at different loci, measured by D = p_AB − p_A·p_B and r² = D² / [p_A(1−p_A)p_B(1−p_B)]. Recombination erodes LD over generations, and LD patterns differ by population history — one reason GWAS hits and PRS transfer imperfectly across ancestries.

zh: r² = 1：兩個 SNP 完全相關，檢定任一個的結果相同。
en: r² = 1: two SNPs are perfectly correlated; testing either gives the same result.

beginner.zh: 效應量回答「每多一個風險版本，影響有多大」。量身高時用 β（多幾公分）；看是否得病時用 Odds Ratio（勝算多幾倍）。
beginner.en: Effect size answers "how much does each extra risk copy change things". For height it is β (extra cm); for disease it is the odds ratio (how many times the odds).

advanced.zh: 連續性狀：β 為每增加一個 effect allele 的性狀平均變化。二元性狀：OR = e^β，β 為 logistic 迴歸係數，即 log(OR)。β 的正負號取決於所選的 effect allele；交換 effect/other allele 時 β 變號、OR 變倒數。
advanced.en: Quantitative traits: β is the mean change per additional effect allele. Binary traits: OR = e^β where β is the logistic coefficient, i.e. log(OR). The sign of β depends on which allele is the effect allele; swapping alleles flips β's sign and inverts OR.

zh: OR = 1.10 → β = ln(1.10) ≈ 0.095；換成另一個 allele 時 OR ≈ 0.91。
en: OR = 1.10 → β = ln(1.10) ≈ 0.095; for the other allele OR ≈ 0.91.

concepts.zh: P 值與全基因體顯著性

beginner.zh: P 值表示「如果其實沒有關聯，看到這麼強結果的機率」。GWAS 一次檢查上百萬個 SNP，很容易碰巧中獎，所以門檻非常嚴格：p < 0.00000005。
beginner.en: A p-value is the chance of seeing a result this strong if there were truly no association. GWAS test millions of SNPs, so lucky hits are common — hence the strict threshold p < 0.00000005.

advanced.zh: 全基因體顯著閾值 5 × 10⁻⁸ 大致相當於對約一百萬個獨立檢定做 Bonferroni 校正（0.05 / 10⁶）。P 值小只代表統計證據強，不代表效應大，也不代表因果；效應量要另外看 β 或 OR。
advanced.en: The 5 × 10⁻⁸ genome-wide threshold roughly corresponds to a Bonferroni correction for ~one million independent tests (0.05 / 10⁶). A small p-value means strong statistical evidence, not a large effect and not causation; look at β or OR for magnitude.

zh: p = 3 × 10⁻⁹ 達全基因體顯著；p = 2 × 10⁻⁶ 則只是「提示性」關聯。
en: p = 3 × 10⁻⁹ is genome-wide significant; p = 2 × 10⁻⁶ is only suggestive.

beginner.zh: 曼哈頓圖是一種呈現 GWAS 結果的圖；圖上的橫線就是全基因體顯著門檻 5 × 10⁻⁸。其座標定義的引用來源尚待驗證（Pending Verification）。
beginner.en: The Manhattan plot is a way to display GWAS results; the horizontal line marks the 5 × 10⁻⁸ genome-wide threshold. The cited definition of its axes is Pending Verification.

advanced.zh: 本系統只發布已驗證部分：顯著閾值線對應 p = 5 × 10⁻⁸。座標軸定義主張（C-GW-09）目前因語料庫中缺少可驗證來源而標記為 Pending Verification，詳見 Evidence 頁。
advanced.en: Only the verified part is published: the threshold line corresponds to p = 5 × 10⁻⁸. The axis-definition claim (C-GW-09) is Pending Verification because no verifiable source is in the corpus; see the Evidence page.

zh: （示意）在簡報中的模擬 GWAS 圖上，超過門檻線的點代表達到全基因體顯著。
en: (Illustrative) On the simulated GWAS figure in the slides, points above the line are genome-wide significant.

beginner.zh: GWAS Catalog 是一個公開的「關聯結果圖書館」，把已發表 GWAS 找到的 SNP–性狀關聯整理起來，任何人都能查。
beginner.en: The GWAS Catalog is a public "library" of SNP–trait associations from published GWAS that anyone can search.

advanced.zh: 由 NHGRI 與 EMBL-EBI 維護，提供人工整理的關聯、summary statistics 與標準化性狀註解，並連結 PGS Catalog。研究者用它取得 PRS 權重來源或比較前人結果。
advanced.en: Maintained by NHGRI and EMBL-EBI, it provides curated associations, summary statistics and standardized trait annotation, linked to the PGS Catalog. Researchers use it to source PRS weights or compare prior findings.

zh: 查詢某性狀，即可看到相關 SNP、效應量、P 值與研究族群。
en: Search a trait to see associated SNPs, effect sizes, p-values and study populations.

beginner.zh: 過去大部分 GWAS 的參與者是歐洲血統。只用某一群人找到的結果，套用到其他族群時不一定準確。
beginner.en: Most past GWAS participants were of European ancestry. Results from one group may not hold as well in others.

advanced.zh: Popejoy & Fullerton（2016）：2009 年 96% 為歐洲血統，2016 年非歐洲約 20%，但非洲、拉丁美洲血統、西語裔與原住民族群合計 <4%。族群間 allele 頻率與 LD 結構不同，造成發現偏差與 PRS 移植性下降。
advanced.en: Popejoy & Fullerton (2016): 96% European in 2009; ~20% non-European by 2016, but African and Latin American ancestry, Hispanic and indigenous groups together <4%. Differences in allele frequencies and LD cause discovery bias and reduced PRS portability.

zh: 某 SNP 在一族群常見、在另一族群罕見，其可檢測性就不同。
en: A SNP common in one population but rare in another has different detectability.
